# NetGuard AI - Models Directory

This directory stores trained model binaries (`.joblib`), fitted preprocessors, and metadata files.

## Artifacts Generated by `python -m ml.train`
- `preprocessor_binary.joblib` / `preprocessor_multiclass.joblib`: Fitted `NetGuardPreprocessor` instances containing training-set median imputers, `RobustScaler` parameters, and ANOVA F-statistic feature selection masks.
- `random_forest_binary.joblib` / `random_forest_multiclass.joblib`: 100-tree Random Forest ensembles.
- `support_vector_machine_binary.joblib` / `support_vector_machine_multiclass.joblib`: Support Vector Classifiers with RBF kernel.
- `k-nearest_neighbors_binary.joblib` / `k-nearest_neighbors_multiclass.joblib`: 5-NN distance-based instance learners.
- `logistic_regression_binary.joblib` / `logistic_regression_multiclass.joblib`: Linear baseline classifiers.
- `multilayer_perceptron_binary.joblib` / `multilayer_perceptron_multiclass.joblib`: Multilayer Perceptron neural networks.
- `anomaly_detector.joblib`: Unsupervised `NetGuardAnomalyDetector` instance with fitted `IsolationForest` and calibrated 0.0–1.0 anomaly scoring.
- `metadata.json`: Active mode, last training timestamp, feature list, and best performing model.

*Security Notice: NetGuard AI only loads trusted, locally generated model files. Arbitrary uploaded pickle/joblib files are strictly rejected.*
